blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The reported shooting incident at Isulan National High School in Sultan Kudarat province on Wednesday was a “false alarm,” Education Secretary Sonny Angara confirmed. Earlier, Governor Datu Pax Ali S. Mangudadatu said in a social media post that there was an alleged shooting incident at the school, but no confirmed reports of injuries or fatalities related to the incident. READ: Sultan Kudarat school principal: No shooting, hostage-taking In a brief media interview, Angara said that the circulating report was not true. “Hindi daw totoo. Mayroong attempt ‘yata, I think there was an attempt, ‘yun lang alam ko,” he told reporters […]... Keep on reading: Angara confirms: Reported Sultan Kudarat school shooting ‘false alarm’
